profitability.heading: Profitability by case type
profitability.description: Fees, payments and expenses grouped by case type. A fee agreement's money is counted under a case type only when it covers at least one case and every case it covers is that type.
profitability.noneDescription: Add case types under Administration → Case types to see this report.
profitability.netReceivedNote: Net received is the amount paid minus expenses not yet reimbursed.
profitability.mixedLabel: Fee agreements covering more than one case type
profitability.mixedExplanation: Agreements whose money can't honestly be given to a single case type: those covering cases of more than one type, those where some cases have no type set, and those with no linked case at all. Their money is shown here instead, with no case count or expenses — those are counted under each case's own type, or as cases with no type, above.
profitability.untypedExplanation: Their case count and expenses are real figures. The fee columns are empty because fee agreements are attributed by case type; agreements covering these cases appear in the last row instead.
